evaluation_design.event_evaluation: Temporally held-out; strict spatial or cross-event independence is not established.
evaluation_design.exclusion_mask: 25 m buffer constructed from all 800 historical polygons, including those later assigned to internal testing.
evaluation_design.uncertainty: Event-level and spatial-block intervals describe fixed-prediction event-sampling uncertainty; training-seed variability is reported separately.

factor_definitions.sources_and_resolutions: Documented in the manuscript and README.

limitations: Published pool_ids.csv represents the saved sampled modeling pool, not every eligible raster cell in the negative-candidate domain. Candidate-cell masks remain private inputs or outputs.
Historical NS2 models using full-positive IV fitting and intermediate models using independent negative splitting are excluded; only final recorded runs are mapped.
Training-only supervised scorer fitting does not establish strict training-only spatial isolation because the exclusion mask uses all historical polygons.
No exclusion sensitivity analysis was conducted for the 125 pre-event historical landslides or for historical polygons overlapping the post-event inventory.
Spatial-block bootstrap depends on the tested block scales and does not establish robustness to historical/event inventory overlap.
The code license does not establish redistribution rights for private geospatial inputs or derived records.
Full reproduction requires the authorized private inputs described in README and DATA_AVAILABILITY.md.
